title.narrative: Kijana Jihusishe: Youth Promoting Peaceful 2022 Elections in Kenya

description.narrative: The overall objective of the action is to contribute to the strengthening of female and male youth leadership capacities for a nonviolent, free, and inclusive 2022 electoral process in Kenya. The project will support female and male youth, including those marginalised, to have the capacity and space to engage constructively in electoral processes, governance and advocacy around cross-ethnic, issue-based politics and accountability, and locally appropriate conflict prevention and response mechanisms.
